aviation_incidents.headline: 威斯康辛州Piper JetProp墜毀造成六人死亡 飛行員曾通報結冰
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架Piper JetProp DLX於2026年10月13日在美國威斯康辛州墜毀，機上五名成人及一名兒童死亡。飛機墜落在威斯康辛州Dellona鎮、Wisconsin Dells附近的林地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Piper JetProp crash in Wisconsin kills six; pilot reported icing
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Piper JetProp DLX crashed in Wisconsin on October 13, 2026, killing five adults and a child. The aircraft went down in a wooded area in the Town of Dellona, near Wisconsin Dells.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 蔣萬安盼與中央合作推動松山機場遷建
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安列席行政院會，會前表示將在會中說明、討論松山機場遷建，並就整體評估交換意見。他也表示，願意與中央共同努力推動遷移目標；目前談及的是遷建議題與合作目標，並非已完成遷建。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an Seeks Cooperation on Songshan Airport Relocation
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an attended an Executive Yuan meeting and said before it that Songshan Airport relocation would be explained and discussed there, with views exchanged on an overall assessment. He also said he was willing to work with the central government to pursue the relocation goal. His remarks described a goal for discussion and cooperation, not a completed relocation.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中華航空更新輕旅行會員計畫，新增碳抵換點數回饋機制
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空股份有限公司表示，輕旅行會員計畫新增點數回饋機制。會員完成「環保旅程（Eco Travel）」碳抵換後，可獲得輕旅行點數；搭配其他挑戰項目累積達8點，即可享有購票優惠。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines adds points for Eco Travel offsets in updated program
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines said its Easy Travel membership program has added a points-reward mechanism. Members can earn Easy Travel points after completing a carbon offset through Eco Travel. When points accumulated with other challenge activities reach eight, members can receive ticket-purchase offers.

international_aviation.headline: 新加坡航空777-9推進首飛準備　消息指煞車與滑行測試已完成
international_aviation.summary: 新加坡航空訂購之一架波音777-9新機正推進首次飛行準備。據航空動態消息指出，機體代號WH291、使用美國註冊編號N20092的航機，已於上個週末完成煞車與滑行測試，首飛暫定安排於10月14日，實際時程仍須依測試整備狀況與作業需求調整。目前尚未取得波音或新加坡航空對該首飛安排的官方確認。
international_aviation.headline_en: Singapore Airlines 777-9 Advances Toward First Flight as Reports Indicate Brake and Taxi Tests Completed
international_aviation.summary_en: A Boeing 777-9 ordered by Singapore Airlines is progressing toward its first flight. According to aviation updates, the aircraft, identified as WH291 and carrying U.S. registration N20092, completed brake and taxi tests last weekend. Its first flight is tentatively scheduled for October 14, subject to testing readiness and operational requirements. No official confirmation of this first-flight schedule has yet been obtained from Boeing or Singapore Airlines.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士評估擴大A350產能，預計近期決定
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士商用飛機部門主管 Lars Wagner 於2026年10月14日在 Toulouse（法國）一場簡報中表示，公司預計近期決定是否擴大A350產能。Wagner說，相關投資仍須董事會批准；航空公司對更多長程客機的需求，是此項產能評估的背景。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus expects to decide soon on expanding A350 production capacity
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus commercial aircraft chief Lars Wagner said on October 14, 2026, that the company expects to decide soon whether to expand A350 production capacity. Speaking at a briefing in Toulouse, France, Wagner said the investment would require board approval. Airlines are seeking more long-haul aircraft, the report said.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士預測2045年航空業人力需求達244萬人
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士在10月14日發布的《全球服務市場預測》中估計，全球航空業到2045年將需要244萬名工作人員。預測列出的需求包括66萬名飛行員、73萬名維修技術人員，以及105萬名客艙組員。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus forecasts aviation industry will need 2.44 million workers by 2045
international_aviation.summary_en: In its Global Services Forecast released on October 14, Airbus estimates the global aviation industry will need 2.44 million workers by 2045. The projected requirement includes 660,000 pilots, 730,000 maintenance technicians and 1.05 million cabin crew.

international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空將在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募活動
international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空將於2026年10月28日及29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募巡迴說明會。公司於10月8日宣佈這項安排，並將與當地招募機構 Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc.（IPAMS）合作。第一天的場次安排在當地時間10時及13時，第二天則於當地時間10時舉行。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates to hold first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines
international_aviation.summary_en: Emirates will hold its first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines on October 28 and 29, 2026. The airline announced the event on October 8 and is partnering with local recruitment agency Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc. (IPAMS). Sessions are scheduled for 10:00 and 13:00 local time on October 28, and 10:00 local time on October 29.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空選定東京 首架空中巴士A350-1000預定12月首航
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空選定東京作為旗下首架空中巴士A350-1000寬體客機的商業首航目的地。漢莎航空於2026年10月15日宣佈，15架A350-1000中的首架預定於2026年12月3日自慕尼黑出發，飛抵東京羽田機場（HND）。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa selects Tokyo for December debut of its first Airbus A350-1000
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa has selected Tokyo as the destination for the first commercial flight of its first Airbus A350-1000 widebody. The airline announced on October 15, 2026, that the first of 15 A350-1000s is scheduled to depart Munich on December 3, 2026, and arrive at Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND).
